files.README.md:
# Vantage Wold Tannery - hide checks

The dye-house checks were fast when they were written and now take most of a coffee break. The team wants
the summary to name the phases that eat the time instead of guessing.

turns.prompt: Vantage Wold Tannery's test suite has grown slow and the team wants the run summary to name the ten phases that take the most time. Give the option that makes the test runner report that list, written as a single token in the --option=value form. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
